title: Suppress YOLO night false-alarms on OUTSIDE_FRONT_SOLAR via env-var enable + per-camera threshold overrides
author: jill (operator-directed 2026-09-15, post alert-quality review of 2026-09-14 night alerts)
plan_section: V2-046 follow-on to V2-025 (gate classifier). Reuses v1 NIGHT_SUPPRESS primitive (Phase 6B.116 §11.47, infra/quick_classifier.py) which v2 inherited but never enabled.
trigger: Operator 2026-09-15: 'I had a bunch of false alarms last night that made it all the way through the way we had addressed that on the version one refactor was to do a tuning to Yolo or do some kind of sensible thing to Yolo, I forget what it was / The cameras haven't been changed, don't mess with those / There was some kind of factor that we had added to Yolo version one that rejected a bunch of stuff.' Alert review on logs/daemon.log (2026-09-13 22:00 → 2026-09-15 06:00) found 921 night alerts on OUTSIDE_FRONT_SOLAR vs 0-3 on other cameras (300-900x spike). 17 alerts with top_class='cat' confidence 0.61-0.69 (default gate threshold cat=0.60 — barely passes), 7 alerts with top_class='person' confidence ~0.55. vision_analyze on alert crop 05079bbc-af35-49cf-a4c5-98e4eeb0f53b confirmed NO actual animal — just a tree branch moving in the wind, motion-diffed in red/white, YOLO hallucinated 'cat' at 64%. v1 refactor's infra/quick_classifier.py contains NIGHT_SUPPRESS logic (Phase 6B.116 §11.47) with env vars MOTION_GATE_NIGHT_SUPPRESS_ENABLED (default 0), MOTION_GATE_NIGHT_CONF_FLOOR (default 0.40), MOTION_GATE_NIGHT_BRIGHTNESS_RATIO (default 1.5), plus 35-class indoor denylist. v2 inherited the same code but the env var is never set AND quick_classifier._apply_night_suppression is not wired into infra/gate.py pipeline.
background: Root cause is two-layer: (1) infra/gate.py default THRESHOLDS_BY_CLASS['cat']=0.60 lets 0.61-0.69 false-positive band slip through on any camera; (2) v1's proven night-suppress filter sits dormant because MOTION_GATE_NIGHT_SUPPRESS_ENABLED=0. Both layers are configurable without code changes — NIGHT_SUPPRESS via .env (the established home for runtime feature flags, US-017b 2026-09-08), per-camera thresholds via config/motion_gate_thresholds.json (the established home for tuning, per US-017b + skill local-ai/farm-surveillance-v2 'tuning parameters, not private data' rule). Cameras are OFF-LIMITS per operator — no Reolink web-UI changes; v2-side fixes only.

operator_guarantees.plist_not_env: Per US-017b (2026-09-08) + operator directive 2026-09-15, NIGHT_SUPPRESS env vars belong in .env (gitignored, mode 600) + .env.example (committed, sanitized). NOT in the plist.

shipping_definition: (a) .env contains MOTION_GATE_NIGHT_SUPPRESS_ENABLED=1 (real value, gitignored). (b) .env.example documents all three NIGHT_SUPPRESS keys with placeholders + comments. (c) config/motion_gate_thresholds.json OUTSIDE_FRONT_SOLAR section contains cat/dog/bird thresholds bumped to suppress 0.61-0.69 conf band AND gate_enabled flags for cat/dog disabled. (d) git commit on main with US-046 in the message. (e) Working tree clean. (f) No camera-side changes.

Do NOT git push to forgejo or GitHub. Operator reviews and pushes.
Do NOT install new skills. Use existing skill set.
Do NOT touch any Reolink camera web-UI. Cameras OFF-LIMITS.

Do NOT modify infra/gate.py THRESHOLDS_BY_CLASS defaults (per-camera overrides in JSON handle the surgical fix).

design_principles: Solution A + C (combined): enable NIGHT_SUPPRESS env flag AND bump OUTSIDE_FRONT_SOLAR per-camera thresholds.
Tuning parameters go in version-controlled JSON (motion_gate_thresholds.json), runtime feature flags go in .env — both follow the existing home established by US-017b.
Minimal surface change. Three files: .env, .env.example, config/motion_gate_thresholds.json.
Per-camera threshold overrides mirror the existing OUTSIDE_FRONT_SOLAR person:0.50 + gate_enabled person:false pattern.
Single commit on main with US-046 in the message.
Operator restarts the daemon manually post-merge to pick up the new .env.
